caption: This miso ramen boasts a rich, amber broth with visible bubbles, topped with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. Served in a rustic ceramic bowl, it rests on a warm wooden table under soft, ambient lighting.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows layered texture with crispy browned edges and tender white interior, irregularly shaped.
The miso broth is amber-brown, glossy, and bubbly, with visible noodles and toppings partially submerged.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
The ceramic bowl has a smooth, earth-toned glaze with subtle speckles and a slightly uneven, rustic rim.
